summary: 19-year-old male fell ~30 ft while down-climbing the back of the First Flatiron in Chautauqua Park; bystanders gave first aid, then Rocky Mountain Rescue Group and City of Boulder OSMP rangers packaged him in a litter and ran a ~4-hour technical evacuation to the trailhead; AMR transported him to a hospital.
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Boulder County Sheriff's Office; City of Boulder Open Space and Mountain Parks; American Medical Response
